title: Utility Services Terms: Household Uplift to the Package Electricity Allowance
content:
# Household Uplift to the Electricity Allowance — Utility Services Program, All-Inclusive Utility Package

**Term.** For the final electricity overage of an All-Inclusive Utility Package account, before proration the monthly electricity allowance is raised by a household uplift set by the approved occupants on the Apartment Home Lease:

1. **100 kWh** when the lease approves at least 4 occupants;
2. **50 kWh** when it approves exactly 3 occupants;
3. **0 kWh** otherwise.

The raised monthly allowance is then prorated by the proration days over the days in period of the account's latest package fee line, to 3 decimals.

## Occupants and uplift

| Approved occupants | Uplift |
|---|---|
| 1 | 0 kWh |
| 2 | 0 kWh |
| 3 | 50 kWh |
| 4 | 100 kWh |
| 5 or more | 100 kWh |

**Record read.** The approved occupants count on the lease, not a count a resident gives.

*Worked case (hypothetical monthly allowance of 600 kWh, 15 proration days over 30):* four approved occupants raise it to 700 kWh, prorated to 350.000 kWh; three occupants give 650 kWh and 325.000 kWh.
